topic.title: Can I use a private Kaggle Dataset for preprocessed data?
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
Hi everyone,

I have a quick question about the external data rules.

I'm planning to use a publicly available dataset with a compatible license. However, preprocessing takes a long time, so I'd like to save the processed data as a private Kaggle Dataset and load it in my submission notebook.

Is this allowed, or do I need to make the processed dataset public as well?

Thanks!😀

comments.content: You can use private dataset and have no need to make it public.

replies.content: That's good to know! Thanks for clarifying!
